About.Author: Author
About.Description: Web application (Blazor Server) that translates PDF, DOCX and ODT documents and images page by page, using local LLM providers (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp) or cloud ones (OpenAI, Gemini, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, etc.). Incremental processing with immediate writes to disk and a built-in viewer for the original pages.
